We are kicking of Friday’s deals with the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, the best price in months on AirPods 4 with ANC, and a chance to score them from $119, but we also have this Apple Watch Series 11 cell model at $130 off and Apple’s latest Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Numeric Keypad still down at its best price ever. You can land iPhone 17 Pro Max at up to $449 off and this base M5 MacBook Pro 1TB with the 96W Apple charger upgrade at $170 off alongside Nomad’s USB-C keychain charging and data transfer tool and deals on almost all of the brand’s Apple Watch bands at up to 25% off. Check it out below.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $145 (Reg. $179)

AirPods 4 with ANC hit best price in months, but here’s how to grab a set for $119 (Reg. $179 new)

Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 are $50 off this week and we are still tracking nearly 25% off the base model AirPods 4 at $99. However, we also saw the latest AirPods 4 with ANC drop to the best price since March this morning at $145 and we wanted to offer up an even lower price on them to those interested – Amazon’s top quality Renewed Premium listing is down at $119 shipped.

Amazon is currently offering Renewed Premium AirPods 4 with ANC down at $119 shipped. Regularly $179 new, this is slightly better than 33% off and the best price we can find from a source as reputable.

Keep in mind this not just some used or refurbished set, but rather an Amazon Renewed Premium unit – highest quality Amazon sells with a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life.”

Rose Gold Apple Watch Series 11 cell model now $130 off, more colors/models down at $299

As we ready for the weekend, we are still tracking solid $100 price drops across a collection of the most affordable Apple Watch Series 11 models, including both the 42mm and the larger 46mm case sizes. While the connected GPS + Cell models have largely gone out of stock, Amazon is offering this Rose Gold model at $130 off the list price today.

Again, you will find the base GPS variants starting down at $299 shipped for the 42mm and $329 for the 46mm, but we wanted to highlight this deal on the 46mm Rose Gold cell variant at $130 off today as well.

Amazon is now offering a solid 25% price drop on the regularly $529 Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cell model in Rose Gold right now. Currently sitting down at $399 shipped, this is $130 off and the best deal around at the moment.

This is the lowest price we have ever tracked on this model outside of a short-lived dip to $379 during Prime Day that went completely out of stock before the event even wrapped up. And just about all of the most notable cell deals this week have jumped up in price quite quickly.

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

Score Apple’s latest Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Numeric Keypad at the Amazon all-time low this week

Alongside this week’s $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3, one of the more surprising hangover Prime Day deals were are somehow still tracking has the Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Numeric Keypad sitting down at Amazon all-time low pricing – clip the on-page coupon if the discount isn’t auto-added in the cart.

It’s not entirely uncommon to see price drops stick around after Prime Day ends. But we are now weeks removed from Amazon’s massive summer shopping bonanza and official Apple accessories are not typically the sort of gear that stays on sale for this long.

Amazon is currently offering the official and latest-generation Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Numeric Keypad down at $143.99 shipped– be sure the on-page coupon is clipped if it isn’t already.

Regularly carrying a $179 list price, and rarely discounted before this extended savings opportunity, you’re looking at the best price we have ever tracked on the latest USB-C model.

It also joins an ongoing deal on the base current-gen Apple Magic Keyboard without the Touch ID and Numpad down at $80, but the deal we have here on the full-size model is even more rare.

Land iPhone 17 Pro Max at up to $449 off in ‘pristine’ condition, or 17 Pro $220 off via Amazon

We are still tracking up to $220 off Amazon Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro units right now, but we wanted to touch down this morning to highlight what is easily one of the best deals to date on iPhone 17 Pro Max – Woot is offering “pristine” conditions units that have “never been in customer hands” at up to $449 off right now.

While the deepest deal comes on the top-end 2TB model, there are price drops available right through the lineup starting with the 512GB model:

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (Reg. $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (Reg. $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (Reg. $1,999)

Color options on select storage capacities are starting to sell out on these unlocked 17 Pro Max models, so it might be a good idea to get in there as soon as possible if you’re interested here.

While not completely brand new, they sit somewhere between the Amazon renewed/refurbished units and the always full price unlocked listings at Apple:

So you’re not getting the official packaging, or an Apple warranty. But they are covered for 1-year and come in “pristine” condition for a whole lot less than buying one straight from Apple. They are fully unlocked.

All of that said, if you’re more interested in iPhone 17 Pro, Amazon’s top quality Renewed Premium units are seeing notable deals this week – they come with a 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life.”

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (Reg. $1,299 new)

Base M5 MacBook Pro 1TB with 96W Apple charger upgrade now $170 off

Amazon is now offering $150 off the most affordable M5 MacBook Pro machines and as much as $400 off the high-end configurations, but we wanted to highlight this deal at B&H that nets you the base model at the same price with the upgraded charger at $170 off.

B&H is now offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB of RAM and the 1TB SSD down at $1,849 shipped.

That’s $150 off the list price and the same deal you’ll find at Amazon on this machine.

However, B&H is also now offering the 16GB/1TB with the 96W Apple charger upgrade – Amazon ships this machine with the standard 70W charger and it costs an additional $20 when you configure this one with the upgraded charger on the Apple site. In other words, you’ll save an extra $20 grabbing this same MacBook at B&H and score a better charger too.

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (Reg. $2,019)
  • Includes Apple 96W USB-C Power Adapter (worth $20)

For comparison’s sake, here’s a look at the best MacBook Pro deals on Amazon this week – there are some higher-end M5 Pro and M5 Max models at $300 and $400 off the new list prices:
